mentions.name: StackToDate
mentions.description: This app monitors the version and support lifecycle of large dependencies, helping track when components in a stack are outdated or approaching end of support.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also, this Christmas I took a rest on Pulso, and I developed a small app to monitor the version & Support Lifecycle of large dependencies. https://stacktodate.club
